sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com), English. The host is not reachable from the build machine, so the text was read from the repo's own snapshot of the wiki pages (the .github/wiki folder: the attribute pages and the spell pages, intro and description) and from the search summaries of the live pages. Quoted facts are the wiki's; nothing was invented.
sources.design: Order and thresholds of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs and the strength of the spell: the sources give no chapter or episode for them. See docs/magic/character_spells_rest.md.
sources.soul_corpse_fix: docs/magic/soul_corpse_fix.md: the generic summons open for any Soul Corpse holder, only Jimmy / David / Alfredo / Carl / Michael Caesal / True Soul Corpse Magic are Rades's. The mastery numbers here repeat the caps of corpse.SoulCorpseAccess (Necropolis 30 percent, Legion 50, David 60, True Soul Corpse 70, Michael Caesal 80) because a character set replaces the mastery order.

spells.name: Soul Corpse (strings of mana on the dead)
spells.note: Mode 0 of the book (always open); the rule only keeps the new-grimoire test at two starters.

spells.name: Soul Corpse Magic: Reanimation
spells.note: He infuses his mana into corpses and controls them; the starter page for every holder.

spells.name: Soul Corpse Magic: Marionette
spells.note: A starter page for every holder (soul_corpse_fix).

spells.name: Soul Corpse (puppet strings)
spells.note: The wiki: the user can control corpses, even without taking out the grimoire.

spells.name: No.1 Carl
spells.note: Rades's special numbered corpse, enhanced with curse power.

spells.name: Soul Corpse (Necropolis)
spells.note: A generic summon: opens at 30 percent like the Soul Corpse fix.

spells.name: Soul Corpse (Legion)
spells.note: A generic summon: opens at 50 percent like the Soul Corpse fix; an army of reanimated corpses.

spells.name: True Soul Corpse Magic
spells.note: His magic evolves when Patolli sacrifices him: he can recall souls and fully revive the dead.

planned.name: Soul Abductor
planned.note: Revives the soul by putting it back into the body; only on the user and those who have been with the user a long time. Not built (no page).

notes: Every rule is mastery only on purpose: the CI self-test magic.soul_corpse_cast opens his six pages at full mastery and a page_uses rule would keep them shut there. The numbering No.0 to No.4 follows the page names of the mod; which corpse the anime showed first was not verified.
